what: [money-path] The Alpaca equity naked sweep (_check_broker_naked_equity_positions) counts a stop that rests but is breached during regular hours as `stop_resting`, i.e. protected. On alpaca_paper/GLD a stop 416.09 rested with GLD ~381 through the whole 9/29 session and never fired; the sweep read it as protection. On alpaca_live a venue-side failure of the same shape would look protected and never escalate. Proposed: when the session is rth and a FRESH last trade has been through the resting stop for longer than N minutes, escalate (page, plus the existing breach-exit path) instead of `stop_resting`. Tier-2 order-path change, to be a HELD PR with tests.
